@pcbeingused333 is attempting to deploy a commit to the **Confident AI** Team on [Vercel](https://vercel.com).

A member of the Team first needs to [authorize it](https://vercel.com/git/authorize?team=Confident%20AI&slug=confident-ai&teamId=team_L1d4ojsSAF07As6tG9hvZoBn&type=github&job=%7B%22headInfo%22%3A%7B%22sha%22%3A%22d75d1c3110e71dea206a6097c6a868f015b2d050%22%7D%2C%22id%22%3A%22QmdyQ7JgpxJGh2twXdA4SZipkEd4qCKXWxgJNrUkrNWPbZ%22%2C%22org%22%3A%22confident-ai%22%2C%22prId%22%3A3270%2C%22repo%22%3A%22deepeval%22%7D).

Rebased onto current `main`: the helpers moved to `deepeval/metrics/utils/generation.py`, so the fix moved with them. The sync path there still lacks the tuple unwrap the async path has; the parity tests pass on the rebased branch.

The red checks come from `main`, not this diff (which only touches `deepeval/metrics/utils/generation.py` and a new test file). The same Lint, Core Tests and Metrics Tests jobs fail on `main` as of 2026-10-12:

- **lint**: black wants to reformat `dataset/utils.py`, `test_run/api.py`, `test_run/test_run.py` and a few others this PR doesn't touch
- **core tests**: `test_sqlite_store.py::test_storage_failure_is_a_warning_not_an_error` (the warning line-wraps `disk I/O error`)
- **metrics tests**: `test_eval_mode_metrics.py::...[MultiTurnMCPUse]`, `CallToolResult` has no `structuredContent` with the current `mcp` release

Vercel only needs team authorization. Happy to rebase once `main` is green.
